summary: M.S. Computer Engineering (RIT, May 2026) — embedded/robotics deployment: vision-guided pick-and-place system (COFFIN) with Jetson + STM32 + multi-sensor I2C/UART/ToF, deployed as production-grade systemd service. Object-tracking turret (YOLO + STM32 + UART) and ROS2 6-DoF arm pipeline. Bare-metal C (STM32 M4), PCB/sensor design, 11 integration failures resolved, operational automation. Seeking to deploy industrial automation at scale — embedded depth + real-time perception + field troubleshooting.

experience.title: MS Capstone — Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN)
bullets: Built vision-guided pick-and-place system: Jetson-side TensorRT YOLO + Arduino C servo control + dual ToF sensors (I2C mux); deployed edge bridge as systemd service with auto-restart and network isolation.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detection, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Multi-layer WebSocket fabric (Flutter → Flask-SocketIO → Jetson) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device registration.

experience.title: Embedded Firmware / Object Tracking Turret

Implemented FreeRTOS mutex-based shared-memory task coordination with user override; verified deterministic real-time operation under multi-task load.
